title: Rice Kheer
description: Slow-simmered basmati rice and milk pudding flavoured with cardamom and saffron, a staple festival sweet across North India.
steps: Bring the milk to a boil in a heavy-bottomed pan, then lower the heat.
Heat the ghee in a small pan, add the drained rice and sauté 1 minute, then add it to the milk.
Simmer on low, stirring often and scraping the base, for 35 to 40 minutes until the rice is very soft and the milk reduces by about a third.
Add the sugar, cardamom, saffron and raisins and cook for 5 more minutes.
Stir in half the almonds and pistachios.
Serve warm or chilled, topped with the remaining nuts.
